name: Living Sacrifices
overview: Scripture calls believers to offer themselves as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, as a rational act of worship grounded in His mercy (Romans 12:1). This commitment involves rejecting conformity to worldly patterns and embracing transformation through the renewal of the mind to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Such faithfulness is marked by obedience and steadfastness in service, which leads to commendation from the Lord (Matthew 25:21), empowered by Christ's sovereign authority (Matthew 28:18). As followers of God, believers are called to live not according to the flesh but as devoted children, reflecting God's character in all they do (Romans 8:12; Ephesians 5:1).
